source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
The complete pinouts are in the sensor board doc. From the main board, the sensor board receives power and signals over two input connectors: a 4-pin JST-PH 2.0mm power connector (5V, GND, 3V3, GND) and a 6-pin JST-GH 1.25mm signal connector (SDA0, SCL0, SDA1, SCL1, UART TX, UART RX).

Each sensor module then receives an output connection:
- SCD41 — 4-pin JST-GH (3V3/GND/SDA0/SCL0)
- BME280 — 4-pin JST-GH
- ENS160 — 4-pin JST-GH
- SPS30 — 5-pin JST-ZH 1.5mm (5V, SDA0, SCL0, SEL→GND, GND); this different connector type matches the SPS30 cable
- ZE08-CH2O — 7-pin JST-GH, matching the supplied cable
- I2C display — 4-pin JST-GH (3V3/GND/SDA1/SCL1)
- One spare I2C0 port — 4-pin JST-GH
- One spare I2C1 port — 4-pin JST-GH

The complete count is 10 connectors.
